note: Both sets capture the main dimensions, the L3X3X1/4 angle profiles, and the 3/8" through bolts, and both carry the same questionable claim of a 5/16" bolt (the text layer shows 5/8", not 5/16"). Set B additionally captures the L3X3X1/4 member profile shown in the Module B detail, which Set A omits. However, Set B adds a duplicate Through Bolt claim that misuses the S-301 reference keynote as a condition, and Set A's first quote is slightly contaminated by appending S-301. On balance B recovers one more supported fact while incurring one extra trivial/duplicated claim.
